tasks.title: w1-env-trace
tasks.objective: Trace every environment variable of the three environments (consumers, required vs optional, schema, validation, placeholders, docs, loaders) and the 14 protected-template items plus the truncated SUPABASE_ANON_KEY of the root production template, without reading or printing any secret value.
acceptance: each template item has a consumer trace and a document-or-remove decision
anon key template classification (A template / B operational / C legacy) with evidence

tasks.title: w2-compat-semantic-groups
tasks.objective: Audit every ledger exception row semantically (concept, legacy alias, canonical field, module, producer, consumer, boundary, reason, removal condition) and classify NECESSARY_BOUNDARY, OBSOLETE_BOUNDARY, MISCLASSIFIED_OPERATIONAL_USAGE or HISTORICAL_ONLY.
acceptance: every row classified with a deterministic rule
obsolete and misclassified rows listed or proven absent

tasks.title: w3-historical-trace
tasks.objective: Validate each of the 115 HISTORICAL_RECORD documents individually (header, frozen body, no executable consumer, no unlabelled normative reference) and find active documents that cite a historical record as current.

tasks.title: w4-decisions-trace
tasks.objective: Trace producers, consumers, semantics and data of the five open product decisions (release status, transactions v2 ledger, shares registry, leads internal notes, external-source columns) without inventing a decision.
acceptance: each decision has producers, consumers, current data and an undeducible question

tasks.title: w5-ci-check-exhaustion
tasks.objective: Exhaust the local sources about the required CI check name (workflows, job names, docs, scripts, rulesets) and state the exact human action for what only an admin can confirm; do not bypass the 403.

tasks.title: w6-destructive-dossier
tasks.objective: Produce the complete approval dossier of every destructive package (40-46, 49, 53, PII backfill, PII scrub): table, columns, census, divergences, archive and restore plan, PITR, size, lock estimate, rehearsal, retention, key custody, dependencies, READY and typed missing requirements. No destruction.
acceptance: every package has all mandatory fields and READY: NO
missing items typed HUMAN_APPROVAL, HUMAN_DECISION or EXTERNAL_REQUIREMENT

tasks.title: w7-pii-key-custody
tasks.objective: Exhaust the non-destructive PII work (dual read, redaction, export, logs, key validation, rotation contract, archive, retention, controlled decrypt, scrub prerequisites) and state exactly what the owner must provide for key custody and escrow.

tasks.title: w8-env-templates
tasks.objective: Edit the protected templates under the owner authorization: remove the unread OPENAI_BASE_URL, document 13 optional variables as placeholders, replace the truncated JWT-looking SUPABASE_ANON_KEY with the canonical placeholder, add the guard that rejects credential-looking template values, clear the pending declarations.
acceptance: guard test rejects a truncated JWT-looking value

acceptance: each spec fails when its boundary is mutated
